dz: Gilles de Rais 是已知最早的连环杀手之一，因南特主教 Jean de Malestroit 对他的指控而被拘留。
de: Gilles de Rais, one of the earliest known serial killers, is taken into custody upon an accusation brought against him by  Jean de Malestroit, Bishop of Nantes.
